color.note: One light theme: design #13 in the Sicily pack (Mediterranean minimal, round 2). The five logo colours fill tiles exactly as before; the neutrals are Sicilian: a ricotta canvas, white tiles, espresso ink and pistachio for the quiet parts of charts. No shadows, no borders: tiles separate by fill and the 16px grid gap.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Ricotta. Page background behind the bento grid, inputs inside the edit sheet, and the one neutral tag chip. Text on it: ink (14.4:1) or ink-muted (7.0:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: White tiles (lists, charts, the Top list), the nav and segmented-control capsules, and every text input. Text on it: ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Espresso. Primary text everywhere; the active nav pill and active segment; primary buttons (Add); text on orange (5.4:1) and gold (7.3:1). 16.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface or canvas: tile labels on white tiles, row meta, chart day labels, the header date, 'all 8 →'. 7.8:1 on surface, 7.0:1 on canvas, 6.6:1 on pill.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text (inputs are always on surface). 8.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a task row inside a white tile.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: Neutral due pills, list counts and loading placeholders. Text on it: ink (13.6:1).

tokens.name: bar-idle
tokens.usage: Pistachio. Chart bars that are not today, and the stub shown for a day with no time logged. Decorative: values are always printed as text too.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Logo colour. Quick add tile (Today), the time report's hero total, the active list in the list selector, tag fill. Text on it: on-orange (ink), 6.0:1.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Logo colour. 'Tracked today' tile, the New task bar, today's chart bar, the 'work' share of time. Text on it: on-blue (white), 5.0:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Logo colour and the 'today' state: 'Spent today' tile, the Today tile on Tasks, today due pills, the 'learning' share. Text on it: on-gold (ink), 8.0:1.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Logo colour and the 'late' state: Next up / Overdue tiles, overdue due pills, Busiest day. Text on it: on-red (white), 4.7:1, so keep text on red at 13px bold or larger.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Logo colour. 'Open tasks' tile, the Someday tile, the 'personal' share. Text on it: on-plum (white), 6.4:1.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange fill.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blue fill.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a red fill.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a plum fill.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Text of the white 'Done' button sitting on a red tile. 8.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: line-on-dark
tokens.usage: 2px outline of ghost pill buttons on plum (the Someday tile's task buttons).

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one hero total of a report page. Its unit or last group is set at 36px (see 'Unit suffix' in the README).

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: A single count that is the whole tile (Open tasks).

styles.name: figure-m
styles.usage: Tag share tiles on reports; the % sign at 24px.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Standard stat tile number (Tracked today, Spent today); unit at 24px.

styles.name: figure-s
styles.usage: Secondary report stats (Busiest day, Per active day); unit at 20–22px.

styles.name: tile-title
styles.usage: A task title that is the subject of a coloured tile (Next up).

styles.name: tile-title-s
styles.usage: Task title in the Overdue and Today tiles on Tasks.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark in the header. Always lowercase.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Title of the main list tile on a page.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Title of a secondary list tile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tile label (top-left of every tile); on white tiles in ink-muted, on colour tiles in the tile's on- colour.

styles.name: form-label
styles.usage: Label of a full-width form tile (16px on the New task bar).

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Task title in a list row; 600 when the row has a meta line under it. One line, ellipsis.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text inputs.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav pills, segmented controls and the header date.

styles.name: list-text
styles.usage: Rows of the compact Top list; values in bold.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Detail line under a tile title; the kind toggle (task / time / spend).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Meta line under a row title (id, tags, priority) in ink-muted.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Due pills and chart value labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart day labels in ink-muted (12.5px on the large report chart).

spacing.note: Measured from the #13 screens. Every gap between siblings is a flex or grid gap.

tokens.name: space-mark
tokens.usage: Gap between the four squares of the mark.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap inside pill groups (nav, segmented controls, kind toggle); gap between a chart value, its bar and its day label.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gap inside a task row and between chips and buttons; below a list tile's title row.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Gap between the parts of a form tile; vertical gap in the header when it wraps; below a chart tile's label.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: The bento grid gap, in both directions.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Header to grid; horizontal gap between header groups; vertical padding of chart and form tiles.

tokens.name: space-tile
tokens.usage: Standard tile padding (all sides; list tiles use 22px 22px 10px).

tokens.name: space-hero
tokens.usage: Padding of a report's hero tile; top padding of the page.

tokens.name: space-page-x
tokens.usage: Left, right and bottom padding of the page (24px top).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Leaf shape: top-left and bottom-right round (32px), the other two tight (6px). Every bento tile, the form tiles and the edit sheet.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Hover shape of a task row inside a tile.

tokens.name: radius-stack
tokens.usage: Rounded top of a stacked day column in report charts (clips its segments).

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Week bars on Today.

tokens.name: radius-check
tokens.usage: The square checkbox of a task row.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Each square of the mark.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Nav, segments, buttons, inputs, chips and due pills.

size.note: Fixed heights and widths of controls; every interactive control is at least 44px except the 34–40px pills that sit inside larger tiles, which keep 44px hit areas through padding where they stand alone.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Quick add input and its Add button.

tokens.name: control-l
tokens.usage: New task bar inputs and Add button.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Standard button height; the checkbox hit area (44 × 44).

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Tag filter chips.

tokens.name: nav-item
tokens.usage: Nav pills in the header capsule.

tokens.name: segment
tokens.usage: Segments of the list selector and the period control.

tokens.name: toggle
tokens.usage: Kind toggle pills (task / time / spend).

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: Visible checkbox square (2.5px border in the task's tag colour).

tokens.name: mark-square
tokens.usage: One square of the mark.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a task row (60px when it has a meta line).

tokens.name: grid-row-min
tokens.usage: grid-auto-rows minimum on Today and reports (140px on Tasks).

tokens.name: chart-week
tokens.usage: Height of the Today week chart.

tokens.name: chart-report
tokens.usage: Height of the report day chart.

tokens.name: bp-single
tokens.usage: At this width and below the bento grid becomes one column, every span resets, and tiles stack in source order.
